TFLite Interpreter WASM from @tensorflow/tfjs-tflite 0.0.1-alpha.10
Copyright 2021 Google LLC. Apache-2.0.
Official package: https://registry.npmjs.org/@tensorflow/tfjs-tflite/-/tfjs-tflite-0.0.1-alpha.10.tgz
Package gitHead: cc8d9d72d2244b50a7f5127900404709595e65fd

Model Lens changes: precompiled 116 fixed embind factories into ordinary JS
functions and replaced the unused legacy global lookup with globalThis.
No browser eval/Function constructor is used. The official WASM is unchanged.
Reproduce with scripts/lib/interpreter-bindings.mjs and its checked-in table.
Only the low-level single-threaded Interpreter is included; TFJS Tensor
conversion, dequantization and the task-library client are not included.
The Emscripten license is preserved separately; the supplemental license
reference tag is not a claim about the package compiler version.
